name: Annex, Article 6, after § 2
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the adoption by the Union of the Agreement on the interpretation and application of the Energy Charter Treaty between the European Union, the European Atomic Energy Community and their Member States
part_text: (2a) The Commission shall submit to the European Parliament and to the Council, no later than six months after the entry into force of this Agreement and thereafter annually, a report on the effects and implementation of the Agreement, in particular with regard to pending proceedings and financial risks for the Member States.
